title: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct official model card
claim: Official checkpoint identity; image-text-to-text interface; Instruct/Thinking variants; Apache-2.0 model license. Source-specific prose deliberately concise.

title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report, arXiv:2511.21631v2
publication_date: 2025-11-27 (v2; v1 submitted 2025-11-26; PDF cover says December 1, 2025)
claim: Section 2 architecture and SigLIP2-Large for 2B/4B; Table 1 S0/S1/S2/S3 token budgets and lengths; Section 3.2 broad data categories and grounding data names; Section 4 SFT, strong-to-weak distillation and RL. Series-level description is not asserted to be complete 2B-Instruct checkpoint-specific recipe. Generic pedagogical examples/formulas are original explanatory examples, not reported training samples.

title: QwenLM/Qwen3-VL official repository
claim: Official 2B release date; DeepStack, interleaved MRoPE and text timestamp architecture descriptions.

title: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct official model configuration
claim: Model-specific text hidden size 2048, 28 layers, vocab151936; vision depth24 hidden1024 patch16 spatialmerge2; maxposition262144. Cross-checked with locally pinned config.json.

title: Hugging Face Transformers: Multimodal chat templates
claim: Multimodal message content consists of text/image blocks; Processor chat formatting and preprocessing; input_ids, attention_mask, pixel_values and image_grid_thw; output IDs decoded to text.

title: Hugging Face Transformers: Qwen3-VL model documentation
claim: Qwen3VL conditional generation interface, multimodal configuration and generate/decode behavior. Do not use incorrect autogenerated header publication date as Qwen3-VL release date.

title: Hu et al. — LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models (2021)
claim: 冻结预训练权重，通过新增低秩矩阵学习适应变化。本文中的本机rank、alpha、可训练参数数目另由本地代码和日志证实。

title: Dettmers et al. — QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs (2023)
claim: 在冻结四位量化底座上反向传播并训练LoRA；NF4、double quantization与分页优化器是论文提出的组成。当前项目仅实现文中说明的子集，未使用分页优化器。

title: Hugging Face PEFT documentation — Quantization
claim: BitsAndBytesConfig的NF4、double quantization、bf16 compute以及prepare_model_for_kbit_training加LoRA的官方训练路径。

title: François Chollet / Keras — Transfer learning & fine-tuning
claim: 冻结预训练层并训练新层；可提前提取并记录固定特征以避免每epoch重复骨干计算；固定缓存不支持不经重提取的动态输入增强。图文状态联合特征与防标签泄漏部分是本项目提出的设计约束，而非该文针对Qwen的实证。

title: Rafailov et al. — Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model (2023)
claim: 偏好数据的直接优化方法，无需显式拟合奖励模型的传统RLHF流程；本项目尚未实施DPO。

title: Ouyang et al. — Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (2022)
claim: 示范监督微调与基于排序偏好的后续RLHF可以组合；该语言模型研究不直接构成本机器人强化学习有效性的证据。
